name: panevrix
description: Keyboard-first dual-panel local file manager with hex and ASCII viewing

scripts.extension:package: npm run extension:build && cd extensions/vscode && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@4.0.0 package --no-dependencies
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check public/editor-bridge.js && node --check extensions/vscode/bridge.js && node --check extensions/vscode/extension.js && node --check lib/operations.js && node --check lib/logging.js && node --check lib/system.js && node --check bin/panevrix.js && node --check public/app.js
